en-US.description: Utility for configuring Windows 10 built-in Defender antivirus settings.
en-US.longDescription: ConfigureDefender is a small utility for configuring Windows 10/11 (and Windows Server) built-in Defender Anti-Virus settings. It is a part of the Hard_Configurator project (including source files), but it can be used as a standalone application (portable).
en-US.name: ConfigureDefender
